market_summary: US100 and BTCUSD remain in strong structural uptrends above session VWAP/VAH but are pulling back from session highs and major resistance/Call Walls under contracting volume. Gold (XAUUSD) continues its bearish momentum flush in a GEX Negative Amplifying regime below its Gamma Flip, presenting a strong trend continuation sell signal. EURUSD and GBPUSD remain bounded inside their Value Areas below VWAP with neutral-to-weak volume profile setups.

GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3991.97) with room down to Session Low support (3982.90). Signal remains bearish continuation.

Price is above VAH (28343.60) and above POC (28267.73). CVD is BULLISH (+12.89) though slope is turning negative (-1.19). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price holds well above VWAP (28213.40) and EMA50 (28323.13), trading between EMA20 baseline and upper ATR band. RVOL is 0.87 (Dukascopy tick volume caveat applies). With positive dampening in place and direct proximity to Call Wall #1 resistance, buying directly into resistance is unadvised.

Price is above VAH (73998.28) and above POC (73660.42). CVD is NEUTRAL/BEARISH (-0.07). In NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is above VWAP (73795.26) and EMA50 (73973.72), resting near S/R support (74254.90) after pulling back from Session High (74706.20). RVOL is low (0.81) with zero yellow volume spikes. CVD divergence and lack of volume expansion warrant holding.
